title: Single-cell atlas
brief: An interactive scanpy-style single-cell UMAP explorer that faithfully reconstructs the human primary motor cortex atlas from Pineda SS, Lee H et al., 'Single-cell dissection of the human motor and prefrontal cortices in ALS and FTLD' (Cell 2024;187(8):1971-1989.e16; DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2024.02.031; GEO GSE174332; ~380,000 nuclei, 64 donors, 46 subtypes) for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, a rare neurodegenerative disease (prevalence ~5-9/100,000). ~4,000 points are generated to respect the study's reported NeuN-sorted (neuron-enriched) cluster structure and coloured by cell type in a clinical qualitative palette across 16 clusters: the glutamatergic excitatory subclasses (L2/3 IT, L5 IT, L6 IT, the L5 ET Betz cells / upper motor neurons, L5/6 NP, L6 CT, L6b), the GABAergic inhibitory subclasses (PVALB, SST, VIP, LAMP5) and the non-neuronal cells (astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, OPCs, microglia, vascular). Cell-class taxonomy and canonical markers follow the BICCN human M1 reference (Bakken et al., Nature 2021, PMC8494640). Features: a legend with per-cluster counts and percentages; click a cluster for its canonical marker genes (each with a one-line function) and abundance; a 'colour by marker gene' toggle that recolours every cell by one gene's embedded per-cluster mean log-normalised expression on a continuous viridis-style scale (SLC17A7 pan-excitatory, GAD1/GAD2 pan-inhibitory, FEZF2/BCL11B/POU3F1/NEFH Betz, AQP4/GFAP/SLC1A2 astrocyte, MOBP/PLP1 oligodendrocyte, PDGFRA OPC, P2RY12/C3 microglia, CLDN5 vascular, and more); hover tooltips; and a Control-vs-ALS toggle that reproduces the study's central finding - the selective depletion of L5 ET Betz cells and the convergent reactive shift in astrocytes and microglia. Labelled throughout as a faithful reconstruction, not a raw download. Research and education, not medical advice.
da: Bioinformatics console: a deep clinical slate/navy ground (not black, not violet plasma), a tasteful clinical qualitative cluster palette (muted indigo/blue excitatory family, clinical rose-red reserved for the vulnerable Betz cells, amber/ochre inhibitory family, teal/sage/slate glia), a restrained probe-cyan for UI only, Manrope for the interface with DM Mono for every gene symbol, fine hairline axes and a subtle inner grid, a right-hand data rail (cluster legend, cluster inspector, study card), a viridis-style continuous ramp for gene expression - a scientist's single-cell notebook, distinct from the three light Curie clinical pieces and from every other library piece.
